fusions.name: Barbed Lure
fusions.desc: Throws a barbed lure that deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Gaff the Weak
fusions.desc: A hooked finishing strike that deals 20 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. For 3 seconds after using it, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Burr Coat
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snag and Slip
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your critical chance rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
